description.value: Kinikinik Store is a convenience store in the remote Cariboo, Chilcotin & Central Interior region of British Columbia, where resupply opportunities for touring cyclists are few and far between. Its OSM-registered location at roughly 52.13°N, 123.70°W places it in a sparsely serviced stretch of interior BC, making any operating store potentially valuable as a waypoint. Website content could not be retrieved, so the full range of services remains unverified.
